_about: The v1b bridge as built, pin by pin, read off the bench's eye (tools/eye.py views at zoom 500, docs/eye-views.json).
done: the wire at this pin was seen in the right hole. check: built, but it reads wrong or the eye cannot settle it; the note says what to look at.
A pin not listed is not built yet, and the marked sheet leaves it in full colour.
Drawn by tools/wiring-diagram.py into docs/wiring-v1b-build.svg; a key that names no pin on the sheet stops the tool.
BASELINE 2026-09-13 15:40 EDT: the camera fixed in place, the wiring as the user left it. Later reads are compared against this one.
scope: grounds, +5 V and the J1 console side

U1.1.note: U1-1: J1's black OUT0 is right, but the short grey from the UNO strip starts in the green's column (D3, TRIG), one below the yellow (D5). Move its strip end up one hole.

A1.D5 (T1).note: A1 D5: nothing leaves the yellow's column on the strip yet; see the U1-1 note.

U2.1.note: U2 and U3 orientation: U1's pin-1 dot and notch face the top (higher columns), as wired. U2's and U3's marks do not resolve on camera; check each notch faces the top too.

U3.1.note: U2 and U3 orientation: U1's pin-1 dot and notch face the top (higher columns), as wired. U2's and U3's marks do not resolve on camera; check each notch faces the top too.

A1.5V.note: A1 5V and GND to the rails: the feed is off the top of the camera's view. Meter 5 V between the rails with the UNO on USB.

A1.GND.note: A1 5V and GND to the rails: the feed is off the top of the camera's view. Meter 5 V between the rails with the UNO on USB.

rails.note: Rails read right with the lead ends in the holes: orange + and brown GND from the left board to the middle board; one red link from the left board's GND column to the right board's GND column (a red wire on GND), one from the middle board's + to the right board's +.

observations: Two yellow ceramic capacitors stand across the rails, on the left board near column 49 and on the right board near column 15; the plan puts one 100 nF beside each chip. The value is not readable on camera.
The red link on GND is correct but red: a black or blue wire there would stop it being read as +5 V later.
The power and reset breakout's five-way housing is parked on the right board's columns 41 to 45; it joins nothing on this sheet.
